source: NBR 15421: use category I (I = 1.0), II (1.25), III (1.5); NBR 6123 Table 3: S3 = 0.95 (group 3, low occupancy), 1.00 (group 2, dwellings, offices, shops), 1.10 (group 1, essential buildings). The categories I-IV are SAEngine's slots; the windImportance holds S3 (the speedFactors method's k1).

I.description: Low occupancy (NBR 15421 category I, I = 1.0; NBR 6123 group 3, S3 = 0.95)

II.description: Dwellings, offices, shops, hotels (category I, I = 1.0; group 2, S3 = 1.00)

III.description: Buildings with many occupants or of substantial risk (category II, I = 1.25; group 2, S3 = 1.00)

IV.description: Essential buildings (hospitals, fire and police stations, communication and power) (category III, I = 1.5; group 1, S3 = 1.10)
